request.initial_prompt: "Well, sir," pursued Joe, "this is how it were. I were at the Bargemen t'other night, Pip;"—whenever he subsided into affection, he called me Pip, and whenever he relapsed into politeness he called me sir; "when there come up in his shay-cart, Pumblechook. Which that same identical," said Joe, going down a new track, "do comb my 'air the wrong way sometimes, awful, by giving out up and down town as it were him which ever had your infant companionation and were looked upon as a playfellow by yourself."

raw_segments.text: Well, sir, pursued Joe, this is how it were. I were at the Bargemen tither night, Pip.
Whenever he subsided into affection, he called me Pip, and whenever he relapsed into politeness, he called me, sir.
When there come up in his shake heart, Pumblechook. Which that same identical, said Joe, going down a new track.
Do comb my air the wrong way sometimes, awful, by giving out up and downtown, as it were him,
whichever had your infant companionation, and were looked upon as a playfellow by yourself.
